searches.result: Only rightkit-fs, rightkit-process & rightkit-ownership are direct active RightKit crate routes.
187 Rust files; zero tracked JS, TS, Swift, package.json or Package.swift files.
Local NDJSON logging, job lifecycle, capacity admission & broker transport found; owner APIs compared before N classification.

self_review: Challenged every non-NA row: RustRight wrappers around rightkit-fs/process/ownership are shared routes, so Y not M. ThinCache is sccache gateway orchestration, not rightkit-cache DiskCache. Broker protocol is not content contracts/framed-sidecar/scenario. Retained N only where owner API directly overlaps active local capability: JSONL logs, job runner contract, local service host transport & pre-spawn resource reservation. Downgraded sandbox/service confidence to medium because RustRight-specific protocol, workspace exclusion & capacity semantics require compatibility mapping.
